rule_set.intent: the truth/belief split is what P2 verification depends on

params.detail: beliefs must not carry a Certainty column — that would make them facts

rule_set.intent: an unverifiable belief silently becomes an assumption

params.detail: every belief must state what P2 has to establish

rule_set.intent: P0 must not promote a System Belief to a Known Fact

params.detail: belief is asserted, not suspected ({token!r}) — state it as a belief or move it to Known Facts
params.pattern: (?i)^(?:there is|there are|the system provides|the system has|it is confirmed|confirmed:)(?=\s)

rule_set.intent: an unanswered question left in a register reads as decided to every later phase

params.detail: {column!r} declares the question unanswered ({marker}) rather than answering it — ask it as a clarification, do not hedge it in a register

rule_set.intent: a blocking question the next phase never sees is answered by invention

params.detail: a blocking clarification is unanswered — resolve it with the named owner and fold the answer into the document before any phase consumes it

rule_set.intent: a business question that outlives the seed is answered downstream by inference

params.detail: only the business can answer this — ask it, fold the answer into the problem statement, and re-author the seed rather than carrying the question forward
